standInReason: yEd, which wrote this file, cannot run on this machine; this is Graphviz's own drawing of gml2gv's conversion (pinned at the file's x/y with neato -n2). gml2gv maps a GML fill to the outline color (no style=filled), keeps GML's y-down coordinates in Graphviz's y-up space (the drawing is mirrored top to bottom), and drops yEd label and edge graphics.

canvas.requested: fit within 1200 x 900 px (size="12.5,9.375!", 96 px per inch)

svgPostprocessing: none: the SVG is Graphviz's output byte for byte
